signature.name: VTask.v
signature.type: {C : Type u} -> [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} C] -> [CategoryTheory.Preadditive C] -> {F G : CochainComplex C ℤ} -> {n : ℤ} -> (γ : CochainComplex.HomComplex.Cochain F G n) -> (p q : ℤ) -> (hpq : p + n = q) -> F.X p ⟶ G.X q

conventions.note: NONE_DECLARED: The function is total and the proof argument hpq structurally guarantees a valid component exists for every input; no junk-value or edge conventions arise.

facts.statement: ∀ {C : Type*} [CategoryTheory.Category C] [CategoryTheory.Preadditive C] {F G : CochainComplex C ℤ} {n : ℤ} (γ δ : CochainComplex.HomComplex.Cochain F G n), γ = δ ↔ ∀ (p q : ℤ) (hpq : p + n = q), VTask.v γ p q hpq = VTask.v δ p q hpq

facts.statement: ¬ ∀ (C : Type*) [CategoryTheory.Category C] [CategoryTheory.Preadditive C] (F G : CochainComplex C ℤ) (n : ℤ) (γ δ : CochainComplex.HomComplex.Cochain F G n) (p q : ℤ) (hpq : p + n = q), VTask.v (γ + δ) p q hpq = VTask.v γ p q hpq
